content: Pluggable collector pattern: core system + plugin modules implementing a common interface (abstract base class / protocol) with standardized methods (fetch, normalize, error handling). New collectors are added by implementing the interface and registering, without touching core orchestration. Multi-source pipelines separate an integration layer (source-specific ingestion/filtering) from a core processing layer (dedup, transform, common logic) from a sink layer (writes to storage). Cross-corroborated across multiple independent sources (Medium, Dagster, Matillion, DZone, arXiv).
